headline: Surprise Drop in Inflation! 12,700 Signal for the Stock Market
summary: September inflation fell below expectations, lifting market mood, and Borsa Istanbul opened higher. An economist said the decline paves the way for a central bank rate cut.
why: Lower inflation raises the likelihood of central bank rate cuts, which tend to support equities and affect lira-denominated assets.
why_moved: Inflation came in below expectations in September, improving the market mood and raising hopes for a central bank rate cut.
